name: Yahya Kamal
role: Computer Science Engineering Student, ENSEEIHT (Toulouse INP)
pitch: I'm drawn to the mathematical foundations of intelligent systems, and I want to learn to build software that puts them to work. I came to engineering school through the Moroccan CPGE track, and I'm now exploring AI, machine learning and research through coursework and projects.

paras: I'm a computer science engineering student at ENSEEIHT (Toulouse INP) on the SN track. Before that, I completed the Moroccan CPGE preparatory programme, which gave me a solid base in mathematics, physics and computer science. It also taught me to approach hard problems with rigour and persistence.

My interests sit between computer science, mathematical reasoning and innovation. I'm especially curious about artificial intelligence, machine learning and research, and I'm also interested in software development and entrepreneurship.

journey.t: I experimented with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, made small games in Unity, and tried Python. These were personal experiments, and they taught me to see programming as a way to turn ideas into working systems.
Two years of intensive mathematics and physics strengthened my abstraction and problem-solving skills.
I want to build engineering skills on that foundation and see how rigorous technical knowledge can lead to useful products and original research.

skills.detail: Two years of CPGE TSI; rigorous reasoning and abstraction; interest in the mathematical foundations of AI and ML
Personal experimentation, CPGE coursework, and introductory object-oriented programming, i also went through harvard's CS50 course.
Explored in middle school and high school
About eight years of use, with more intensive configuration and exploration recently (i use arch btw)
Exploring system configuration and development workflows

These interests are exploratory: I plan to refine my direction through coursework, independent projects, internships and research opportunities.

Investigate entrepreneurship as a possible long-term path.
